disambiguation: Not a general HTML viewer; it is specifically designed for design-time UI prototyping of Obsidian plugins.
intentEvidence: Mockup Viewer solves this: - Save HTML into Mockup/foo.html — the preview appears instantly.
motivation: The author built it to solve the pain of iterating on Obsidian plugin UI, which requires constant building and reloading, and to allow testing mockups against real Obsidian styles.
problem: Iterating on Obsidian plugin UI is difficult because plain HTML misses Obsidian's CSS variables and host classes, and reloading the entire plugin is cumbersome.
summary: A design-time tool for plugin authors that renders HTML mockups inside an isolated iframe, injecting necessary CSS for accurate UI prototyping.
